Story Spotlight — When AI Flagged the Hidden Risk

During a pilot with a strategic merchant partner, the copilot flagged anomalous language in a self-attestation that human reviewers overlooked.

  • The LLM cross-referenced historical approvals and raised a confidence-weighted alert about a new data export pattern.
  • Partner engineering confirmed an undocumented change that would have introduced a GDPR violation in the EU region.
  • We translated the alert into updated policy guidance and retrained the copilot prompt to watch for similar breaches.
Takeaway

Responsible AI infused with institutional context can outpace traditional checklists without sacrificing human oversight.
